senses.gloss: שָׁאֵר (denom. of מֵשָׁאר, v. מֵישָׁרָא) to plant in beds.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 81a:8">B. Kam. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>שַׁאֲרֵיה מֵשָׁארֵי לאדם וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>שדיא משראי לשראי</he>, read: <he>משארי משארי</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if he planted in beds, it shows that he planted it for human food; if not, it is intended for cattle.
